description:
Model of an American sedan of the 90s in a police package. The design is inspired not only by famous police cruisers of the 90s, but also by cab-forward designs, to give a more European appearance to the body.

I unconditionally give you permission to use this model at your discretion, modify it or implement it into a digital product. Use the model as you see fit and have a nice day.

Uptade: The body geometry has been updated - the absurd proportions have become less absurd. Pushbar removed, small features added. Body material now got it UV Unwrapped.
